senses: A king of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.16.20;
12th king of Judah, son of Ahaz and Abijah; a good king in that he served Jehovah and did away with idolatrous practices
son of Neariah, a descendant of David
head of a family of returning exiles in the time of Nehemiah

strongs.def: Chizkijah, a king of Judah, also the name of two other Israelites
strongs.from: or חִזְקִיָּהוּ; also יְחִזְקִיָּה; or יְחִזְקִיָּהוּ; from H2388 (חָזַק) and H3050 (יָהּ); strengthened of Jah
